name: Як це називається? Захист (1)
description:
In this lesson, one of you pieces is in danger. If you don't defend it, you'll lose your piece. Like in a real game, it is up to you to figure out how to defend. 

After your move, a question appears, asking you what your defense is called. Tick the correct answer.

What do you have to do?

Find the right way to defend your piece and answer the question.

texts: Avoid losing material by capturing an attacker.
